name: Vector Studio Modular Baseline
javascript_architecture: ordered classic-script feature modules; shared legacy global lexical scope
description: Modular baseline with professional Layers panel v1: live SVG thumbnails and unified vector visibility/lock controls.
notes: 3D Revolve Expand 2D now resolves the current projected view: visible side faces are unioned into compound vector geometry and receive a multi-stop linear gradient sampled from the rendered 3D shading; visible caps remain separate vector shapes. Extrude expansion remains face-based.
v87 adds Object > Flatten Bitmap Colours with live palette/edge/noise/smoothing preview and flattened-copy output.
Bitmap Colour Flattener now traces cleaned palette regions into native editable SVG compound paths instead of creating a flattened raster copy.
Bitmap vectorizer adds edge-run line fitting/straightening and hides the source raster after SVG conversion.
Bitmap vectorizer v92 replaces jagged pixel-outline output with cubic Bezier curve fitting via Paper.js simplify; long straight runs collapse and curved boundaries use smooth handles.
Bitmap Colour Flattener dialog is viewport-bound with responsive preview, independently scrollable settings, and always-visible action footer.
v94 hard viewport containment for Bitmap Colour Flattener: fixed top/bottom insets, scrollable body, fixed footer, short-screen preview compression.
Clean release packaging: index.html loads only styles.css + app.bundle.js; archived versioned CSS/JS excluded.

v96 fixes the Bitmap Colour Flattener structurally: all settings are before the preview canvases, Edge Straightening is restored in the HTML, settings are sticky, and image preview dimensions cannot push controls below the viewport.
